notes:
Lead summary:
- SMB e-commerce startup selling curated home goods (DTC + marketplace channels). 12 employees, small infra team.
- Primary asks: product page Q&A (instant answers to specs, materials, sizing), automatic attribute extraction for older catalog entries (title, size, material), reranking for search results.
- Traffic profile: steady baseline low qps, but bursty spikes during weekend promos and email drops (observed peaks ~120-160 rps). Concerned about throttling during spikes.

Technical requirements / preferences:
- Prefer Hosted API (self-serve) to avoid infra overhead; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/cache to reduce cost.
- Model preference: cost-conscious open models (7B-13B) with quantized variants for cheaper fallbacks. Asked about recommended model variants for Q&A vs. rerank.
- Latency SLO: targeting p95 <= 400ms for text Q&A, prefer <250ms if possible.
- Need streaming for UI snappy feel.
- Security: not regulated, but require SSO for admin console and audit logs for product edits. No immediate on-prem/VPC need.

Commercial / process notes:
- Came via inbound form + open-source blog on product Q&A. Wants to start with free credits then convert to pay-as-you-go. Very cost-sensitive; expects small ARR first year.
- Quote from CTO: "We need accuracy on specs — if the model hallucinates product measurements we lose trust quickly."
- Competitor check: evaluating against OpenAI hosted endpoints for latency/cost; also looked at small vendors that offer retail-focused models.

POC goals / success criteria:
- Demonstrate 95th percentile latency <400ms under 150 rps bursts, with graceful degradation/fallbacks.
- Attribute extraction: achieve >= 92% precision on 500 legacy SKUs for size/material fields.
- Hallucination rate <5% on factual product fields (measure via prompt tests).
- Cost per query target: <$0.015 average after batching / caching.

Open questions / blockers:
- Need clarity on burst provisioning and temporary rate increases (can we auto-burst on hosted api?).
- Admin SSO setup: how long to enable for trial customers?
- Need sample pricing estimate for 150 rps weekend burst for a 48-hour campaign.

Next steps:
- SE to send Optimize config suggestion + quickstart prompts (done 2026-03-10).
- Customer to upload 500 SKU sample + run 48-hour weekend replay test.
- Check-in 2026-03-17 to review telemetry and discuss next steps for dedicated capacity if bursts are recurring.
